topic: Claiming a Phone Warranty at the Counter

script.title: SAVED BY THE SCREEN
script.story_hook: A cracked screen almost ruined a free warranty repair.
script.intro_zh: 一條裂痕，差點讓免費保固泡湯。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today a phone visits the warranty counter. Listen for repair words.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天一支手機來到保固櫃台求助。留意維修的說法。
script.outro: Small defect, big relief. Bring receipts, ask questions. See you next time!
script.outro_zh: 小毛病，大鬆口氣。帶好收據、多問一句。下次見！
script.practice_intro_en: Listen once more and repeat each line with care.
script.practice_intro_zh: 再聽一遍，每行都用心跟著唸。
script.char_a_description: a woman in her mid-thirties with straight jet-black hair tucked behind her ears, a camel-colored wool coat, a red scarf, brown leather gloves, average build
script.char_b_description: a young man in his early twenties with curly light brown hair, black-rimmed glasses, a gray tech polo shirt, a lanyard ID badge, slim build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, is this the warranty counter?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ɪz ðɪs ðə ˈwɔɹənɾi ˈkaʊntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 請問這裡是保固櫃台嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sure is. What seems to be the problem?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈʃʊɹ ɪz wʌt siːmz tə bi ðə ˈpɹɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 正是。您的手機有什麼狀況？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen flickers, then it shuts down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skɹin ˈflɪkɚz ðɛn ɪt ʃʌts daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 螢幕會閃爍，然後自己關機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Annoying. How often does that happen?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈnɔɪɪŋ haʊ ˈɔfən dʌz ðæt ˈhæpən/
dialogue.zh: 很惱人耶。多久發生一次？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A few times a day, and it dies fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə fju taɪmz ə deɪ ənd ɪt daɪz fæst/
dialogue.zh: 一天好幾次，電也掉超快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sounds like a battery or board issue.
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz laɪk ə ˈbætɹi ɔɹ bɔɹd ˈɪʃu/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來是電池或主機板的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it still under warranty?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt stɪl ˈʌndɚ ˈwɔɹənɾi/
dialogue.zh: 還在保固期內嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: When did you buy it?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn dɪd ju baɪ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 您是什麼時候買的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost exactly one year ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst ɪɡˈzæktli wʌn jɪɹ əˈɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 差不多剛好一年前。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let's check. Do you have the receipt?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛts tʃɛk du ju hæv ðə ˈɹisɪpt/
dialogue.zh: 那我們查一下。收據還在嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's saved in my email — let me find it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts seɪvd ɪn maɪ ˈiməl lɛt mi faɪnd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 存在email裡，我找找看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time. I'll run a quick test.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jʊɹ taɪm aɪl ɹʌn ə kwɪk tɛst/
dialogue.zh: 您慢慢來，我跑個快速檢測。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it is — August eighteenth.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ ɪt ɪz ˈɔɡəst ˈeɪˈtinˌθ/
dialogue.zh: 找到了，八月十八號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, one year of coverage, nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt wʌn jɪɹ ʌv ˈkʌvɹɪdʒ naɪs/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，保固有一年，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So they'll fix it for free?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðeɪl fɪks ɪt fɚ fri/
dialogue.zh: 所以可以免費修好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me look at the screen closer first.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi lʊk æt ðə skɹin ˈkloʊsɚ fɜɹst/
dialogue.zh: 我先仔細看一下螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay... um, is something wrong?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ʌm ɪz ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɹɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好的……呃，是有什麼問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a crack in the corner here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹz ə kɹæk ɪn ðə ˈkɔɹnɚ hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 這裡的角落有一條裂痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no. Does that kill the warranty?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ dʌz ðæt kɪl ðə ˈwɔɹənɾi/
dialogue.zh: 糟了，裂痕會讓保固失效嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually damage isn't covered, let's see.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuːʒəwəli ˈdæmɪdʒ ɪzənt ˈkʌvɚd lɛts si/
dialogue.zh: 通常損壞不在保固範圍，我們再看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait — I know that mark!
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt aɪ noʊ ðæt mɑɹk/
dialogue.zh: 等等！那個痕跡我知道！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You do?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju du/
dialogue.zh: 您知道？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's just my screen protector cracking.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts dʒʌst maɪ skɹin pɹəˈtɛktɚ ˈkɹækɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那只是保護貼裂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Huh. Let me peel it back... you're right!
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌ lɛt mi pil ɪt bæk jʊɹ raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 咦，我掀開看看……真的是！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the actual glass is fine?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ði ˈæktʃuəl ɡlæs ɪz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 所以裡面的玻璃是好的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally clean. That saves your claim.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊtəli klin ðæt seɪvz jʊɹ kleɪm/
dialogue.zh: 完全乾淨，你的申請有救了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What a day... okay, what's next?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ə deɪ oʊˈkeɪ wʌts nɛkst/
dialogue.zh: 今天真是的……好，接下來呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next, we need your data backed up.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst wi nid jʊɹ ˈdeɪtə bækt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 接下來，需要先備份你的資料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My cloud storage is full, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ klaʊd ˈstɔɹɪdʒ ɪz fʊl ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 可是我的雲端空間已經滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can use our Wi-Fi and backup station.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn juz aʊɚ ˈwaɪˌfaɪ ənd ˈbækˌʌp ˈsteɪʃən/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以用店裡的WiFi和備份站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would that copy everything?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ðæt ˈkɑpi ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那樣能複製全部資料嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Photos, messages, all of it, yeah.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtoʊz ˈmɛsɪdʒəz ɔl ʌv ɪt jɛ/
dialogue.zh: 照片、訊息，通通都在內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. How long will the repair take?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt haʊ lɔŋ wɪl ðə ɹɪˈpɛɹ teɪk/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，修理要多久時間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About three days for the battery swap.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt θɹi deɪz fɚ ðə ˈbætɹi swæp/
dialogue.zh: 換電池大概要三天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three days? I need my phone!
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹi deɪz aɪ nid maɪ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 三天？我每天都要用手機啊！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We offer a loaner, if you want one.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈɔfɚ ə ˈloʊnɚ ɪf ju wɑnt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以借你一支備用手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? That's a lifesaver, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli ðæts ə ˈlaɪf ˌseɪvɚ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？那簡直是救星。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It only makes calls and texts, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈoʊnli meɪks kɔlz ənd tɛksts ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不過那支只能打電話、傳訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's totally fine with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈtoʊtəli faɪn wɪz mi/
dialogue.zh: 那樣我就很滿意了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you want us to remove your SIM now?
dialogue.phonetic: /duː ju wɑnt ʌs tə rɪˈmuv jʊɹ sɪm naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 現在要幫你把SIM卡取出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, please. Is my number kept?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliːz ɪz maɪ ˈnʌmbɚ kɛpt/
dialogue.zh: 好的，請問我的號碼會保留嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, the SIM carries your number.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ðə sɪm ˈkæɹiz jʊɹ ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 會的，號碼就在SIM卡上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Should I take off this case?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ʃʊd aɪ teɪk ɔf ðɪs keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 好。手機殼要先拆下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and we'll bag everything together.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ənd wɪl bæɡ ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ təˈɡɛðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 要拆，我們會把東西全裝進袋子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's the tool for the SIM tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹz ðə tul fɚ ðə sɪm treɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這是開卡槽的小工具。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, you're prepared! That helps.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ jʊɹ pɹɪˈpɛɹd ðæt hɛlps/
dialogue.zh: 哇，您準備得真周到！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I read the store's guide online first.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɹæd ðə stɔɹz ɡaɪd ˈɑnˌlaɪn fɜɹst/
dialogue.zh: 我先到網上看過你們店的指南。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Sign here and this is done.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt saɪn hɪɹ ənd ðɪs ɪz dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。在這裡簽名，手續就完成了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One thing — when does my warranty end?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn θɪŋ wɛn dʌz maɪ ˈwɔɹənɾi ɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，我的保固何時到期？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next month, so you timed it well.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst mʌnθ soʊ ju taɪmd ɪt wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 下個月，所以你掐的時間剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, lucky me. Can I text about status?
dialogue.phonetic: /hælˈki mi kæn aɪ tɛkst əˈbaʊt ˈsteɪtəs/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我真幸運。可以用訊息問狀況嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Text this number any day before six.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst ðɪs ˈnʌmbɚ ˈɛni deɪ bɪˈfɔɹ sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 隨時傳訊到這個號碼，六點前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. When do you close today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt wɛn duː ju kloʊz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 收到。今天幾點關門？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven sharp, but we're closing early today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən ʃɑɹp bət wɪɹ ˈkloʊzɪŋ ˈɜɹli təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 七點整，不過今天會早一點關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah, that explains the empty waiting area.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ðæt ɪkˈspleɪnz ði ˈɛmpti ˈweɪtɪŋ ˈɛɹiə/
dialogue.zh: 難怪！等候區空空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We shut down at six this Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ʃʌt daʊn æt sɪks ðɪs ˈfɹɑɪˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這週五下午六點就不收件了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glad I came this afternoon, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡlæd aɪ keɪm ðɪs ˈæftɚˌnun ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那還好我今天下午就來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'll get the loaner and a receipt.
dialogue.phonetic: /jul ɡɛt ðə ˈloʊnɚ ənd ə ˈɹisɪpt/
dialogue.zh: 這支備用手機和收據都給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you so much for making it easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ fɚ ˈmeɪkɪŋ ɪt ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你把整個過程變得這麼輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enjoy the rest of your day, bye!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðə ɹɛst ʌv jʊɹ deɪ baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 祝你今天剩下的時間愉快，再見！

script.youtube_title: 【保固救援】「裂痕只是保護貼！」手機維修實錄｜🎧60句聽力｜備份資料、備用手機、保固期限｜A2初級｜不用背多聽就會用｜Warranty Counter
script.youtube_title_en: "That Saves Your Claim" — Claiming a Phone Warranty at the Counter
script.youtube_description:
手機螢幕閃爍，去維修櫃台該怎麼說？這段「保固申請」美式英語聽力帶你全程通關！🎧

一位顧客的手機一天當機好幾次，到了櫃台又擔心角落那條裂痕會讓保固失效。結果你猜怎麼了？那只是保護貼裂開！你會聽到從查保固、備份資料到借用備用手機的完整對話。

這一集重現手機維修櫃台的真實流程：確認保固期、出示收據、雲端空間不夠怎麼辦、三天維修的取機安排。每句都不超過十個詞，A2 初級聽得懂。

你會聽到：
🔸 說明故障：The screen flickers, then it shuts down.
🔸 保固危機：Does that kill the warranty?
🔸 意外轉機：That's just my screen protector cracking.
🔸 取件安排：We offer a loaner, if you want one.

🎧 後半段是逐句聽力加跟讀練習，同一句先聽母語語調，再開口複製一次，把六十分鐘的句子聽到會說。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用，維修、保固、備份的說法一次學好。

看完記得按讚、訂閱並打開小鈴鐺，每週新增一段生活情境聽力。留言告訴我們：你的手機修過最糟的一次是什麼情況？

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_en: Phone acting up? Learn exactly how to claim a warranty at a repair counter with this A2 American English listening practice. A customer's screen keeps flickering and shutting down, and a crack in the corner almost wrecks the free repair — until they discover it is only the screen protector. Listen to the full counter conversation: checking coverage, finding the emailed receipt, backing up data when the cloud is full, borrowing a loaner phone, and arranging a three-day repair. Every line is short and real, full of words like warranty, coverage, backup, and loaner. The second half of the video is a sentence-by-sentence listen-and-repeat session so the phrases stay with you. Subscribe for a new daily-life dialogue every week, and tell us about your worst phone repair story in the comments.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧手機保固英文｜保固查詢・資料備份・備用手機｜聽完就能說｜🌱A2初級英文｜💡不用背多聽就會用
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
手機螢幕一直閃爍，該怎麼請店裡用保固免費修？角落有裂痕，保固還管不管用？雲端空間滿了又該怎麼辦？
這一集帶大家走進手機維修櫃台，看顧客和工程師一起過關斬將，從查保固到借備用手機。
你會聽到：
🔸 說明故障｜「The screen flickers, then it shuts down.」三句話講清楚手機症狀。
🔸 保固危機｜「Does that kill the warranty?」聽懂裂痕和保固的關係。
🔸 意外轉機｜「That's just my screen protector cracking.」虛驚一場的真實說法。
🔸 取件安排｜「We offer a loaner, if you want one.」修機期間怎麼不斷線。

後半段是逐句聽力加跟讀練習 🎧 先聽母語語調，再開口複製，把六十分鐘的維修英語聽到會說。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用，下次手機出問題就能自己搞定櫃台。

願你的每個壞消息，最後都只是保護貼裂開。
script.thumbnail_action: handing a phone across the repair counter
